methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); oil and gas producer signals

pit_profile.why: FY16 10-K: 'We are an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas.' Risk factors: 'The oil and natural gas industry is cyclical, which can result in shortages of drilling rigs, equipment, raw materials (particularly sand and other proppants), supplies and personnel.' and 'Our revenues, operating results, profitability, future rate of growth and the carrying value of our oil and natural gas properties depend significantly upon the prevailing prices for oil and natural gas.' The kind is CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own word for its industry (the CB and LYB rule): the earnings are the oil price; of the live disruption themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles': none names an oil and gas producer; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12, scoped to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining'): Diamondback's reserves are oil and gas and its climate legislation risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Diamondback

theme_watch.reason: Live: Diamondback's own FY16 10-K says 'The adoption of climate change legislation by Congress could result in increased operating costs and reduced demand for the oil and natural gas we produce.' The stock trades at 27.2x FY17E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of Diamondback's oil and gas reserves specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY13-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +122.1%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.8-yr ex-FY12 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +182.2%/yr (FY13-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +182.2%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY13-FY14: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: FANG (retrospective, 2017-10-06) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.05x (39.4% downside to Bear $60 / +724.5% upside to Bull $817) | Adj composite 2.90 vs market 1.00: gap +1.90 [UNDERVALUED] | +94% above the EPP floor $51 (14x FY17E $3.64) | Conservative 2-yr case: +327.0% total (+163.5%/yr) | At 27.2x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $131 sits at or below the BASE case; oil-equivalent production +108.9% and oil production +116.4% in Q2 2017, forward revenues +139.5% (no FY17 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2017 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
